name: International Scholarship Programme of the Avicenna Studienwerk
summary: The International Scholarship Programme (ISP) of the Avicenna Studienwerk, in cooperation with the Islamkolleg Deutschland, supports international Muslim students and doctoral candidates with funds from the Federal Foreign Office
